items.question: Which UAE federal law governs consumer protection?
items.gold: Federal Law No. 15 of 2020 on Consumer Protection.
items.fact: Consumer protection is governed by Federal Law No. 15 of 2020.

items.question: Which UAE federal decree law regulates commercial companies?
items.gold: Federal Decree Law No. 32 of 2021 on Commercial Companies.
items.fact: Commercial companies are regulated by Federal Decree Law No. 32 of 2021.
